name: Chevening Scholarships
eligible: Citizens of Chevening-eligible countries with at least 2 years' (2,800 hours) work experience after their first degree; must return home for 2 years after the award. UK/dual British citizens not eligible.
covers: Fully funded (tuition, living allowance, travel) — see site for the breakdown
deadline_text: 6 October 2026, 11:00 UTC

name: Commonwealth Master's Scholarships
provider: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK
eligible: Citizens or refugees of eligible Commonwealth countries, resident there, with at least a 2:1 first degree, who could not otherwise afford UK study
covers: Return airfare, full tuition, monthly stipend, study travel grant, child allowance where applicable
deadline_text: 20 October 2026, 16:00 BST

name: Commonwealth PhD Scholarships (Least Developed Countries and Vulnerable States)
provider: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK
eligible: Citizens or refugees of 17 eligible Commonwealth countries (e.g. Bangladesh, Nigeria, Pakistan, Uganda, Zambia), resident there; must not have started a PhD before September 2026
covers: Airfare, tuition, monthly stipend, study travel grant, fieldwork costs, mid-term home visit, family allowances
deadline_text: 20 October 2026, 16:00 BST

name: Gates Cambridge Scholarship
provider: Gates Cambridge Trust, University of Cambridge
subjects: All fields (excludes MBA, MFin, PGCE, MASt, clinical/MD)
eligible: Citizens of any country outside the UK applying for a full-time PhD, MLitt or one-year postgraduate course at Cambridge
covers: Full cost of study (fees and maintenance) — see site for the breakdown
deadline_text: US residents: 14 October 2026. Others: 8 December 2026 or 6 January 2027, depending on course

name: Rhodes Scholarship
eligible: Applicants from Rhodes constituencies worldwide; each constituency sets its own rules and deadlines
covers: Oxford fees, annual stipend, visa and health surcharge, two economy flights, settling-in allowance
deadline_text: Varies by constituency — 2027 round open; most constituencies closed Aug–Sep 2026, last listed closing date 7 October 2026 (USA)

name: Clarendon Scholarships
eligible: Any nationality. No separate application: you are considered automatically if you apply to Oxford by your course's December or January deadline
covers: Full course fees and a living-expenses grant
deadline_text: Your Oxford course deadline (December 2026 or January 2027)

name: DAAD Research Grants – Doctoral Programmes in Germany
eligible: International graduates with above-average results, degree completed no more than 6 years before the deadline
covers: Monthly payment, health/accident/liability insurance, travel allowance, €460 annual research allowance, rent subsidy, language course
deadline_text: Varies by country — check the DAAD database

name: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
provider: U.S. Department of State, via national Fulbright Commissions / US Embassies
eligible: Graduate students and young professionals from about 160 countries; rules vary by country
covers: Varies by country — check with your local Fulbright Commission or US Embassy
deadline_text: Set by each country — check site

name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters Scholarships
eligible: Students worldwide with a bachelor's degree (or finishing one before the programme starts); apply to each programme directly
covers: Tuition waived; scholarship covers travel, visa, installation and living costs
deadline_text: Varies by programme — most close between October and January

name: Marie Skłodowska-Curie Doctoral Networks
eligible: Any nationality, no doctorate; must not have lived or worked mainly in the host country for more than 12 of the last 36 months
covers: Employment contract with living allowance, mobility allowance and family allowance where applicable
deadline_text: Per vacancy — search EURAXESS

name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships
provider: Swiss State Secretariat for Education, Research and Innovation (SERI)
subjects: All fields (research track); a master's track exists for arts only
eligible: Early-career researchers from 183 countries with a master's degree, aged 35 or under, with a Swiss academic supervisor
covers: Monthly scholarship — see site for other coverage
stipend_text: CHF 2,450 per month (PhD; postdoc scholarships end from 2027/28)
deadline_text: Country-specific — 2027/28 applications open since 20 August 2026; deadlines set by the Swiss embassy in your country

name: France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship
provider: French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs / Campus France
eligible: International students nominated by a French university (no direct applications); 29 or under for master's, 35 or under for doctoral
covers: Monthly allowance, travel, insurance, housing help, cultural activities (tuition not included)
stipend_text: €1,200 per month (master's); €2,000 per month (doctoral) — rates from January 2026
deadline_text: 2027 campaign not yet published (last one closed 8 January 2026)

name: Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship – Research Students
eligible: Non-Japanese nationals born on or after 2 April 1992 (2027 guidelines) with 16+ years of education; via Japanese embassy or university recommendation
covers: Tuition and fees waived, return airfare, monthly allowance
deadline_text: Embassy round for 2028 arrival runs April–May 2027

name: Global Korea Scholarship (GKS) – Graduate
provider: National Institute for International Education (NIIED), Korea
eligible: Non-Korean citizens (and both parents), under 40, GPA 80% or above
covers: Tuition, 1 year of Korean language training, monthly and academic allowances, airfare
deadline_text: Announced February 2027; applications February–March 2027

name: Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC)
eligible: Non-Chinese citizens, through bilateral, university and other CSC tracks
covers: Could not be confirmed — official site did not load
deadline_text: Varies — check site

name: Australia Awards Scholarships
provider: Australian Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT)
eligible: Citizens of participating developing countries
covers: Could not be confirmed — official pages did not load
deadline_text: 2028-intake dates not yet published

name: Research Training Program (RTP) Scholarships
eligible: Domestic and international research students; apply through each university
covers: Tuition offset, living stipend, research allowances
deadline_text: Set by each university

name: Canada Graduate Research Scholarship – Doctoral (CGRS-D)
eligible: Doctoral students at Canadian institutions; up to 15% of awards open to international students already registered in a Canadian PhD
covers: Annual scholarship
deadline_text: 19 October 2026 (institutional deadlines are earlier)

name: Stipendium Hungaricum
eligible: Nationals of partner countries with a bilateral agreement with Hungary
covers: Tuition waiver, monthly stipend, dormitory or housing contribution, medical insurance, Hungarian language course
stipend_text: HUF 43,700 per month (master's, 2026/27 call) + housing contribution
deadline_text: 2027/28 call not yet published (last one closed 15 January 2026)

name: Swedish Institute Scholarships for Global Professionals
eligible: Nationals of SI-eligible countries with work and leadership experience
covers: Could not be confirmed — official page did not load
deadline_text: Varies — check site

name: Türkiye Scholarships (Türkiye Bursları)
eligible: International students under 30 (master's) or under 35 (PhD) with at least 75% academic standing (90% for health sciences)
covers: Tuition, monthly stipend, dormitory, health insurance, Turkish language course, travel
stipend_text: TRY 9,500 per month (master's); TRY 13,000 per month (PhD)
deadline_text: Usually 10 January – 20 February each year

name: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships
provider: New Zealand Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade
eligible: Citizens of eligible countries, 18+, with 1 year of full-time work experience and IELTS 6.5; must commit to 2 years of home-country contribution
covers: Full scholarship — see site for the breakdown
deadline_text: Current round closed; next dates not published

name: Joint Japan/World Bank Graduate Scholarship Program
eligible: Nationals of eligible developing countries with 3+ years of development work experience and unconditional admission to a participating programme
covers: Tuition, medical insurance, round-trip airfare, US$600 travel allowance, monthly subsistence allowance
deadline_text: Window 1: 18 Jan – 26 Feb 2027; Window 2: 29 Mar – 21 May 2027
